{{AttributeInfobox |image1 = Bloated.png |type = Status Effect |effects = Altered Health
Altered Size
Altered Speed |sandbox = No }} ==Description== '''Scale''' is a status effect which alters the health, size and speed of an enemy. ==Mechanics== When an enemy receives '''Scale''', its health, speed and size will be altered either temporarily or permanently. This can be both positive, like a speed boost or negative, like a health decrease. By default, the values were 50% more health, 50% size increase and its speed being set to 75%, though these values are rarely used. '''Scale''' still exists in the game, though it has mostly been replaced by [[Nimble]] and [[Bloated]] attributes. ==Enemy List== No enemy spawned with '''Scale''' naturally. The following event enemies applied '''Scale''' to other enemies: *[[Witch (Lunar Overture)|Witch]] ([[Lunar Overture Event|Lunar Overture]]) **Temporary 6 second buff, gave anywhere between 30% to 100% more health, made enemies 35% larger and made them slower by 20%. *[[Reaper (Lunar Overture)|Reaper]] ([[Lunar Overture Event|Lunar Overture]]) **Permanent upon summoning an enemy. **[[Sin (Lunar Overture)|Sin]]: ***Chance to gain 100% more health, an increase in size and a speed decrease. **[[Hallow Guard (Lunar Overture)|Hallow Guard]] ***Guaranteed to have its health reduced by anywhere between 16.7% and 0%, have its size decreased and speed increased. **[[Demon (Lunar Overture)|Demon]] ***Guaranteed to have its health reduced by 50%, have its size decreased and speed increased. The [[Bloated]] attribute used to at one point increase enemy size using '''Scale''', with the size being set to anywhere between 15% and 25% bigger, while health and speed multipliers were set to having no change, though this is no longer the case. ==Update History== *'''28 October 2023''' - [[v1.9.0]] **'''Scale''' added. {{AttributeNavBox}}
